proofs.rationale: The private subscription decoder fallback expects partition-specific subscriptions. Public Subscription contains only a Set TopicName, and Consumer.subscribe constructs exactly one partition -1 entry per unique topic. Released native subscribe copies this list; subscription returns the saved topic list. Empty subscriptions yield no entry and every nonempty public entry takes SubscribedPartitionsAll. Manual assignments use a distinct API and do not change subscription. Specific partition decoding is therefore unavailable through this public subscription path; native queries and their errors are still exercised.

The entire private SubscribedPartitions fallback has the same source-proven domain restriction as its ps argument: all public subscription entries are unique topic/-1 pairs. Both multiple-topic and regex subscriptions observe the exact All representation; this is not a general exclusion of subscription IO or decoding.

Only the nullPtr argument at columns 50-68 is unforced. GHC 9.12.4 Storable (Ptr a) expands STORABLE with sizeOf _ = SIZEOF_HSPTR. Pointer size, negative/overflow bounds and the native allocation boundary are exercised; the ignored pointer value cannot acquire a hit.
